title: Silksong Finally Has DLC, Switch 2 Price Hike, and the Worst Patch of the Year | Respawn Weekly #212
creator: Respawn Weekly
description:
Rach and Dan talk the week in games: Silksong's first expansion, the Switch 2 price bump, and a patch notes disaster.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/respawnweekly
Submit questions: https://respawnweekly.com/ask

sentences.t: Welcome back to Respawn Weekly, I'm Rach, and as always I'm joined by Dan.
Hello, hello, I've had four hours of sleep and it's entirely Silksong's fault.
Which is perfect, because that's our first story, Team Cherry dropped a trailer for the first Silksong expansion, and it's coming out in, like, spring.
I genuinely did not expect them to announce anything this fast.
Right, these are the people who went quiet for six years.
The trailer has a whole new area that looks like it's underwater, and there's a new tool that I think is a grappling hook.
If that's a grappling hook, I'm gonna lose my mind, the movement in this game is already so good.
They also said it's free, which, in this economy, wow.
Speaking of this economy, story number two, Nintendo is raising the price of the Switch 2 in a bunch of regions.
Yeah, about thirty to fifty bucks depending on where you live, and they're blaming tariffs and component costs.
I get it, but it still stings, especially for people who were waiting for a holiday deal.
My take is, if you were on the fence, this is the week to buy before it changes, but don't panic buy either.
Very balanced, very responsible, I hate it.
Hey Dan, do you know who's sponsoring this week's episode?
Uh, is it the snack people again?
Nope, it's Raycon!
Oh nice, I literally have mine in right now.
So Raycon makes wireless earbuds that sound great and don't cost three hundred dollars.
I use the gaming ones on my Switch because the latency is super low, so the audio actually lines up with what's happening on screen.
And the battery lasts forever, I think I charged mine last Tuesday.
Go to buyraycon.com/respawn to get fifteen percent off sitewide, that's buyraycon.com/respawn.
Okay, story number three, and this one is a mess.
So you know that big extraction shooter that's been in early access forever?
The one with the frog mascot?
That one, they pushed a patch on Monday that was supposed to fix matchmaking, and instead it wiped a bunch of people's stashes.
Like, months of loot, just gone.
I saw one guy post that he'd been saving a legendary rifle for a tournament, and it just vanished.
That's genuinely heartbreaking, I would quit for a week.
And the patch notes said, minor bug fixes, which is just incredible.
To their credit they rolled it back in about twelve hours and they're giving everyone a compensation package.
Sure, but people put a hundred hours into some of those stashes, a free skin doesn't fix that.
Honestly, the bigger problem is trust, people are going to be scared every time there's a patch now.
Yeah, they really need to start testing these on a public server first.
Okay, listener question time, this one's from Marco in Ohio.
He asks, what's a game you love that you would never recommend to anyone?
Oh, easy, for me it's a farming game where every crop can kill you, and I will not elaborate.
You absolutely have to elaborate, but we're out of time, so next week.
Thanks for listening, everybody, send us your questions, and we'll see you next week.
